title: Ali Rahimi's talk at NIPS(NIPS 2017 Test-of-time award presentation)
summary: Ali Rahimi's NIPS 2017 Test-of-Time award talk, in which he argues that modern machine learning has become alchemy, working without being rigorously understood. He calls for more rigor and understanding in the field.
why: HN points to it as the sharpest, most-quoted critique of deep learning practice, and cites it whenever ML reliability or understanding is debated.

quote.text: For a more cutting and insightful critique, watch Ali Rahimi's short talk at NIPS 2017
